arguments.content:
import pandas as pd

path = "budget.xlsx"
xl = pd.ExcelFile(path)
print("Sheets:", xl.sheet_names)

for sheet in xl.sheet_names:
    df = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=sheet, header=None)
    print(f"\n=== Sheet: {sheet} (shape {df.shape}) ===")
    print(df.to_string(max_rows=60, max_cols=30))

import zipfile

wb = zipfile.ZipFile("budget.xlsx")
print("=== workbook.xml ===")
print(wb.read("xl/workbook.xml").decode("utf-8"))
print("\n=== workbook rels ===")
print(wb.read("xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels").decode("utf-8"))
